query:
UPDATE otlp_export_state
            SET watermark = GREATEST(watermark, NOW() - make_interval(secs => $2::DOUBLE PRECISION)),
                watermark_id = CASE
                    WHEN NOW() - make_interval(secs => $2::DOUBLE PRECISION) > watermark THEN ''
                    ELSE watermark_id
                END,
                last_success_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE signal = $1
